device.name: APO 1m Ash Dome rotation (ASCOM Alpaca dome server)

facts.text: The dome app registers the dome device type with init_routes(falc_app, 'dome', dome).
The dome app serves every route from one wsgiref simple_server with serve_forever.
start_dome_device constructs one APOAshDome(logger=logger) for the dome responders.
The azimuth responder returns the dome_dev.azimuth attribute; it does not call get_azimuth.
get_azimuth recomputes azimuth from the encoder position, enc.pos/steps_per_degree + HOME_POSITION modulo 360, and stores it in self.azimuth.
The shutterstatus responder returns dome_dev.shutterstatus as an integer.
ShutterState defines open 0, closed 1, opening 2, closing 3 and error 4.
abortslew calls dome_dev.abort_slew().
abort_slew calls stop; stop writes relay DOME_POWER 0 and sets slewing false.
rotate calls stop, resets the encoder, sets the DOME_DIRECTION relay, then switches the DOME_POWER relay on and sets slewing true.
set_relay sleeps 0.2 s after every relay call.
open_upper and close_upper drive UPPER_POWER and start a Timer(upper_time, ...) held in a local variable that schedules set_upper_open or set_upper_closed.
UPPER_TIME is 86 and LOWER_TIME is 120.
open_shutter returns without opening when APOSafety.issafe() is false.
close_shutter closes the upper shutter when lower is false and then runs close_louvers, which executes /home/ocs/bin/ms1 off 9.
monitor_weather and reset_watchdog loop forever and call close_shutter when issafe() is false and the shutter is neither closed nor closing.
The slewtoazimuth responder casts the Azimuth form field to int, rejects a value outside 0..360 and calls dome_dev.slewtoazimuth(azimuth).
slewtoazimuth calls close_shutter instead of slewing when issafe() is false and the shutter is neither closed nor closing; otherwise it starts a thread running gotoazimuth.

gotoazimuth returns without rotating when the target is within DOME_TOLERANCE; otherwise it calls rotate, polls get_azimuth in a loop without a sleep until within DOME_TOLERANCE/4 of the target offset by one degree or 180 s, then calls stop.
DOME_TOLERANCE is 3.
park starts a thread only when not atpark; sendpark calls slewtoazimuth(park_position).

home starts a thread only when not athome; sendhome calls rotate(1) and waits up to 180 s for the home switch; only when the switch asserts does it switch DOME_POWER off and clear slewing, and when the timer expires it only logs.
atpark compares the encoder azimuth with park_position within DOME_TOLERANCE; set_park stores the current azimuth as the park position.
APOSafety.stat sends a UDP request and waits in recvfrom on a socket without a timeout, then exec()s a slice of the reply.
The watchdog thread toggles a relay on the dome control board every two minutes; the control box has an internal timer that closes the dome after 3-4 minutes if the relay is not reset.

safe_state.description: Dome rotation relay commanded off by AbortSlew and the server's slewing flag read back false; not sensed motion (the dome coasts). Shutter timers, the weather and watchdog threads and the louvers are outside the stop, and a slew thread that has not yet run rotate() can re-energise the relay after it; the dome's power switch is the real stop.
